_comment: Reviewer overrides on the computed measure ranking, per sector.
The model is not the last word, and it should not pretend to be: a reviewer reading
the sector reads things the model has no parameter for. An override is therefore
allowed and is never silent — `rank` and `reason` are both rendered on the measure
page, next to the computed components they displace, so a reader can see exactly
where the machine stopped and a person started.
sources/check_importance.py fails the build on a rank without a reason. That is the
only rule: an override with a stated reason is legitimate, an override without one is
Empty on purpose. Cement's first ranking has not been reviewed yet.
